payload.title: Screen continuous E011 uncertainty before any new implementation
payload.decision: Do not clone or ingest the current composite public frontier. Run a bounded preimplementation screen using existing legal OOF artifacts to measure E011-versus-E006 fallback/blend oracle headroom and cross-fitted uncertainty learnability. A formal E013 experiment is allowed only if the screen shows material headroom and reproducible transfer; otherwise close the path.
payload.rationale: Exact source audits show the new frontier is one overlap/model-package lineage; its PF branch and continuity moves are material only on visible well 00e12e8b, the 100-well selector lacks causal ablations, and the stochastic-TTA gate fails its own OOF threshold. E012 already rejects hard regimes. Continuous uncertainty-conditioned placement is the only distinct clean-room hypothesis supported by multiple weak signals.
payload.revisit_trigger: Only a frozen worth screen with oracle headroom at least 0.20 RMSE and a legal cross-fitted branch gaining at least 0.03 RMSE, winning at least 4/5 maps and 17/25 cells without p90 or shift failure may authorize E013 preregistration.
